Card Q&A.q: If I have a Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait in my hand, do I have to place it under my [Yggdrasill_7D6] in the breeding area as its bottom digivolution card for this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Deletion] Place 1 Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait from your hand as the bottom digivolution card of one of your [King Drasil_7D6] in the breeding area.
